# Functions

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
plot_expression_violin <- function(
    df, 
    score_col,  
    title = "Gene Expression", 
    subtitle = "CMF_TGF vs CMFHM_TGF",
    colors = colorvalues,
    comparisons = list(c("CMFHM_NC", "CMFHM_TGF"))
) {
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = orig.ident, y = .data[[score_col]], fill = orig.ident)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, color = NA, scale = "area") +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, color = "black", outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    
    # stat_compare_means(
    #   comparisons = comparisons,
    #   method = "wilcox.test",
    #   label = "p.signif" 
    # ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title    = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x        = "",
      y        = ifelse(score_col == "Mean_Expression", "Mean Expression", paste(score_col, "Expression"))
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 10, hjust = 0),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

```

## Safe the matrix

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
tf_auc_matrix <- acts %>%
  filter(statistic == "ulm") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = "condition", names_from = "source", values_from = "score") %>%
  column_to_rownames("condition") %>%
  as.matrix()

# sanity check before saving — catch problems now, not after reloading elsewhere
stopifnot(is.matrix(tf_auc_matrix))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(rownames(tf_auc_matrix))))
message("Saving tf_auc_matrix: ", nrow(tf_auc_matrix), " cells x ", ncol(tf_auc_matrix), " TFs")
```

# In macrophages

In macrophages: ALDH1A2 increased upon TGF-B stim. Retinaldehyde (Vitamin A) is made to retinoic acid 
There's different isoforms of retinoic acid : 
All-trans-retinoic acid acts by binding to the retinoic acid receptor (RAR), which is bound to DNA as a heterodimer with the retinoid X receptor (RXR) in regions called retinoic acid response elements (RAREs). Binding of the all-trans-retinoic acid ligand to RAR alters the conformation of the RAR, which affects the binding of other proteins that either induce or repress transcription of a nearby gene (including Hox genes and several other target genes). RARs mediate transcription of different sets of genes controlling differentiation of a variety of cell types, thus the target genes regulated depend upon the target cells.

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

Seurat::DefaultAssay(Data) <- "RNA"

target_gene <- "ALDH1A2"
"ALDH1A2" %in% rownames(Data)

Celltype <- "Macrophages"
comp <- c("CMFHM_TGF", "CMFHM_NC")
plot_subtitle <- "CMFHM_NC (No TGF-B) vs CMFHM_TGF (With TGF-B)"


# Extract metadata alongside target gene expression directly

df_plot <- FetchData(Data, vars = c("orig.ident", "cell_type", target_gene), layer = "data") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(cell_type == "Macrophages", orig.ident %in% comp)

# 2. Generate Violin Plot for single gene
p_violin <- plot_expression_violin(
  df = df_plot, 
  score_col = target_gene,     
  title = paste(Celltype, ":", target_gene, "Expression"),
  subtitle = plot_subtitle
)

print(p_violin)


Mac <- subset(Data, cell_type == "Macrophages") 

FeaturePlot_scCustom(Mac, feature = target_gene, split.by = "TGF_status")

```

# Vizualize Target gene expression proportions

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

expr_vec <- FetchData(Mac, vars = target_gene, layer = "data")[[target_gene]]
summary(expr_vec)

p_density <- ggplot(data.frame(x = expr_vec), aes(x = x)) +
  geom_density(color = "#005EA8", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Gene Expression Density",
    x = "Normalized Expression",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0))
p_density

# find a better cutoff estimation - if we use cells with > 0 expression we also include noise

# get density object
d <- density(expr_vec)

# search for the lowest point between 0 and 1
valid_range <- d$x > 0 & d$x < 1.0
trough_x <- d$x[valid_range][which.min(d$y[valid_range])]


cat("Optimal cutoff:", round(trough_x, 3), "\n")



# Add an expression status column to metadata (using hte calculated cutoff before)
Mac$Expression_Status <- ifelse(
  expr_vec > trough_x, 
  paste0(target_gene, "+"), 
  paste0(target_gene, "-")
)

# get counts
cellCounts <- table(Status = Mac$Expression_Status, TGF_status = Mac$TGF_status)

# Generate both Barplot (stacked and filled)

p1 <- ggplot(data = as.data.frame(cellCounts), aes(x = TGF_status, fill = Status, y = Freq)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#005EA8", "#E4E6E8"), c(paste0(target_gene, "+"), paste0(target_gene, "-")))) +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(
    title = paste("Count of", target_gene, "Expressing Cells across Conditions"), 
    x = "", 
    y = "Count of Cells",
    fill = "Status"
  )+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0))

p2 <- ggplot(data = as.data.frame(cellCounts), aes(x = TGF_status, fill = Status, y = Freq)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#005EA8", "#E4E6E8"), c(paste0(target_gene, "+"), paste0(target_gene, "-")))) +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(
    title = paste("Proportion of", target_gene, "Expressing Cells across Conditions"), 
    x = "", 
    y = "Proportion of Cells",
    fill = "Status"
  )+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0))


print(p1)
print(p2)
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

Celltype <- "Cardiomyocytes"

CM <- subset(Data, cell_type == "Cardiomyocytes") 

# Extract metadata alongside target gene expression directly in a loop


for (target_gene in RARRAX) {
  
  Seurat::DefaultAssay(Data) <- "RNA"
  
  df_plot <- FetchData(Data, vars = c("orig.ident", "cell_type", target_gene), layer = "data") %>% 
    dplyr::filter(cell_type == "Cardiomyocytes")
  
  # 2. Generate Violin Plot for single gene
  p_violin.exp <- plot_expression_violin(
    df = df_plot, 
    score_col = target_gene,     
    title = paste(Celltype, ":", target_gene, "Expression"),
    subtitle = "Gene Expression per Condition")
  
  Seurat::DefaultAssay(Data) <- "tfsulm"
  
  df_plot <- FetchData(Data, vars = c("orig.ident", "cell_type", target_gene), layer = "data") %>% 
    dplyr::filter(cell_type == "Cardiomyocytes")
  
  # 2. Generate Violin Plot for single gene
  p_violin.act <- plot_expression_violin(
    df = df_plot, 
    score_col = target_gene,     
    title = paste(Celltype, ":", target_gene, "Activity"),
    subtitle = "Infered TF Activity per Condition"
  )
  
  print(p_violin.exp + p_violin.act)

}


```

# Vizualize Target gene expression proportions

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}

for (target_gene in RARRAX) {
    
  Seurat::DefaultAssay(Data) <- "RNA"
  
  df_plot <- FetchData(Data, vars = c("orig.ident", "cell_type", target_gene), layer = "data") %>% 
    dplyr::filter(cell_type == "Cardiomyocytes")
  
  expr_vec <- FetchData(CM, vars = target_gene, layer = "data")[[target_gene]]
  summary(expr_vec)
  
  p_density <- ggplot(data.frame(x = expr_vec), aes(x = x)) +
    geom_density(color = "#005EA8", linewidth = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(target_gene , " Gene Expression Density"),
      x = "Normalized Expression",
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0))
  
  
  # find a better cutoff estimation - if we use cells with > 0 expression we also include noise
  
  # get density object
  d <- density(expr_vec)
  
  # search for the lowest point between 0 and 1
  valid_range <- d$x > 0 & d$x < 1.0
  trough_x <- d$x[valid_range][which.min(d$y[valid_range])]
  
  
  cat("Optimal cutoff:", round(trough_x, 3), "\n")
  
  
  # Add an expression status column to metadata (using hte calculated cutoff before)
  CM$Expression_Status <- ifelse(
    expr_vec > trough_x, 
    paste0(target_gene, "+"), 
    paste0(target_gene, "-")
  )
  
  # get counts
  cellCounts <- table(Status = CM$Expression_Status, Ident = CM$orig.ident)
  
  # Generate both Barplot (stacked and filled)
  
  p1 <- ggplot(data = as.data.frame(cellCounts), aes(x = Ident, fill = Status, y = Freq)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#005EA8", "#E4E6E8"), c(paste0(target_gene, "+"), paste0(target_gene, "-")))) +
    theme_bw() + 
    labs(
      title = paste("Count of", target_gene, "Expressing Cells"), 
      x = "", 
      y = "Count of Cells",
      fill = "Status"
    )+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0))
  
  p2 <- ggplot(data = as.data.frame(cellCounts), aes(x = Ident, fill = Status, y = Freq)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#005EA8", "#E4E6E8"), c(paste0(target_gene, "+"), paste0(target_gene, "-")))) +
    theme_bw() + 
    labs(
      title = paste("Proportion of", target_gene, "Expressing Cells"), 
      x = "", 
      y = "Proportion of Cells",
      fill = "Status"
    )+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0))
  
    p_density_overlay <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = df_plot[3], color = orig.ident, fill = orig.ident)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colorvalues) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colorvalues) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(target_gene , " Gene Expression Density"),
      x = "Normalized Expression",
      y = "Density",
      color = "Condition",
      fill = "Condition"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0),
      axis.text.x   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text.y   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.title.x  = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y  = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
    
  p_density_overlay <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = df_plot[[3]], color = orig.ident, fill = orig.ident)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colorvalues) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colorvalues) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(target_gene , " Gene Expression Density"),
      x = "Normalized Expression",
      y = "Density",
      color = "Condition",
      fill = "Condition"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0),
      axis.text.x   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text.y   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.title.x  = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y  = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  print(p_density / p1 | p_density_overlay / p2)
  
}

```

# Vizualize Target gene TF inference Activity

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}

for (target_gene in RARRAX) {
    
  Seurat::DefaultAssay(Data) <- "tfsulm"
  Seurat::DefaultAssay(CM) <- "tfsulm"
  
  df_plot <- FetchData(Data, vars = c("orig.ident", "cell_type", target_gene), layer = "data") %>% 
    dplyr::filter(cell_type == "Cardiomyocytes")
  
  expr_vec <- FetchData(CM, vars = target_gene, layer = "data")[[target_gene]]
  summary(expr_vec)
  
  p_density <- ggplot(data.frame(x = expr_vec), aes(x = x)) +
    geom_density(color = "#005EA8", linewidth = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(target_gene , " TF Activity Density"),
      x = "Inferred Activity",
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0))

  
  
  # Awe just to ned. and pos activity
  CM$Expression_Status <- ifelse(
    expr_vec > 0,
    paste0(target_gene, "+"),
    paste0(target_gene, "-")
  )
  # CM$Expression_Status <- case_when(
  #   expr_vec > 0.1 ~ paste0(target_gene, "+"),
  #   expr_vec < -0.1 ~ paste0(target_gene, "-"),
  #   TRUE           ~ paste0(target_gene, "0") # Default fallback for expr_vec == 0
  #   )
  
  # get counts
  cellCounts <- table(Status = CM$Expression_Status, Ident = CM$orig.ident)
  
  # Generate both Barplot (stacked and filled)
  
  p1 <- ggplot(data = as.data.frame(cellCounts), aes(x = Ident, fill = Status, y = Freq)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#005EA8", "#9F1C67", "#E4E6E8"), c(paste0(target_gene, "+"), paste0(target_gene, "-"), paste0(target_gene, "0")))) +
    theme_bw() + 
    labs(
      title = paste( target_gene, "Directional Activity"), 
      x = "", 
      y = "Count of Cells",
      fill = "Status"
    )+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0))
  
  p2 <- ggplot(data = as.data.frame(cellCounts), aes(x = Ident, fill = Status, y = Freq)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#005EA8", "#9F1C67", "#E4E6E8"), c(paste0(target_gene, "+"), paste0(target_gene, "-"), paste0(target_gene, "0")))) +
    theme_bw() + 
    labs(
      title = paste( target_gene, "Directional Activity"), 
      x = "", 
      y = "Proportion of Cells",
      fill = "Status"
    )+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0))
  
    p_density_overlay <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = df_plot[3], color = orig.ident, fill = orig.ident)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colorvalues) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colorvalues) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(target_gene , " Inferred Activity Density"),
      x = "Inferred Activity",
      y = "Density",
      color = "Condition",
      fill = "Condition"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0),
      axis.text.x   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text.y   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.title.x  = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y  = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
    
  p_density_overlay <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = df_plot[[3]], color = orig.ident, fill = orig.ident)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colorvalues) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colorvalues) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(target_gene , " Inferred Activity Density"),
      x = "Inferred Activity",
      y = "Density",
      color = "Condition",
      fill = "Condition"
    ) +
    theme(

    )

}
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
d <- density(expr_vec)

# search for the lowest point between 0 and 1
valid_range <- d$x > 0 & d$x < 1.0
trough_x <- d$x[valid_range][which.min(d$y[valid_range])]


cat("Optimal cutoff:", round(trough_x, 3), "\n")



# Add an expression status column to metadata (using hte calculated cutoff before)
CM$Expression_Status <- ifelse(
  expr_vec > trough_x, 
  paste0(target_gene, "+"), 
  paste0(target_gene, "-")
)

# get counts
cellCounts <- table(Status = CM$Expression_Status, Ident = CM$orig.ident)

# Generate both Barplot (stacked and filled)

p1 <- ggplot(data = as.data.frame(cellCounts), aes(x = Ident, fill = Status, y = Freq)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#005EA8", "#E4E6E8"), c(paste0(target_gene, "+"), paste0(target_gene, "-")))) +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(
    title = paste("Count of", target_gene, "Expressing Cells across Conditions"), 
    x = "", 
    y = "Count of Cells",
    fill = "Status"
  )+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0))

p2 <- ggplot(data = as.data.frame(cellCounts), aes(x = Ident, fill = Status, y = Freq)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#005EA8", "#E4E6E8"), c(paste0(target_gene, "+"), paste0(target_gene, "-")))) +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(
    title = paste("Proportion of", target_gene, "Expressing Cells across Conditions"), 
    x = "", 
    y = "Proportion of Cells",
    fill = "Status"
  )+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0))



p_density_overlay <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = df_plot[[3]], color = orig.ident, fill = orig.ident)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colorvalues) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colorvalues) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = paste0(target_gene , " Expression Density across Conditions"),
    x = "Normalized Expression",
    y = "Density",
    color = "Condition",
    fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.y   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.title.x  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y  = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_density_overlay)


print(p1)
print(p2)
```
